investigations.name: corpus-reproduction
investigations.title: BioModels corpus reproduction — every model across every simulator
investigations.description: A corpus-scale reproduction study: every BioModel we could fetch and parse (1008 models) was simulated under up to five independent ODE engines (amici, copasi, pysces, simbio, tellurium) via the batch-compare-biomodels composite, fanned out over the whole corpus with the Ray runner. The full per-model, per-engine, per-variable timecourse (14.7M rows) is the result; the corpus explorer (Analyses tab) browses it model-by-model.
investigations.question: Across the full BioModels corpus, do independent ODE simulators (COPASI, Tellurium, simbio, AMICI, PySCeS) reproduce the same trajectories for the same model — and where do they diverge?
investigations.hypothesis: Standards-based SBML/SED-ML models should integrate to the same solution regardless of engine; systematic cross-engine disagreement flags either a model-encoding ambiguity or an engine-specific numerical behaviour, not a "correct" answer.
